name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: 32x32 pixel art sprite of a single solak, an elite Janissary archer of the sultan's personal palace guard, standing in ceremonial stillness, rendered across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Male, early 30s, tall and immaculately postured, fair unblemished skin kept from the sun by palace duty, a precisely trimmed mustache with clean-shaven chin, dark hair concealed beneath a tall white felt üsküf headdress — taller and more ornate than the common börk — its polished brass kaşıklık holder set with a tall white plume. Wearing a flowing white silk over-robe atop a fine kaftan, immaculately pressed, a red silk sash tied with ceremonial precision, pristine white şalvar trousers, soft leather boots without a scuff. A finely lacquered composite bow is held at rest in one hand, an ornate quiver inlaid with silver thread slung across the back, a jewel-pommeled yatağan at the hip purely for ceremony rather than war. Expression impassive, almost statuesque, the trained stillness of a man who stands beside the sultan for hours without moving. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
